reason: Actual PR body, README and STATUS explicitly accept only a scoped partial proof: over C, strict low-support J equals the two-sided Serre ideal I in the E_i-generated convolution algebra when every connected Cartan block is A1/A2/B2, all positive integral symmetrizers including nonminimal and independent disconnected blocks. Arbitrary symmetrizable Cartan matrices, G2 and arbitrary higher-rank connected blocks remain unresolved. The full constructible-function-algebra analogue is excluded as false; strict threshold, ordinary d=Dr and relative E-filtered/locally free ambient conventions are retained. All-rank PBW and rigidity/detector checks within these types do not establish the original conjecture. GLS and Lusztig dependencies/examples are explicitly credited; no novelty/priority or full solution claimed.
